Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The urine analysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, positive nitrites, and >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, indicating a urinary tract infection. Presence of blood and low specific gravity are noted, but no casts or ketones. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy.
